source_refs.note: Characteristics of Cross Product: a main subheading of 2.3 Product of two vectors, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 25-25.

blocks.text: 1. A⃗ × B⃗ aur B⃗ × A⃗ barabar nahi, is liye cross product non-commutative (order badlo to jawab badal jata hai) hai:
2. Do perpendicular vectors (θ = 90°) ka cross product maximum (sab se zyada) magnitude ka hota hai, kyun ke sin 90° = 1:

blocks.text_alt: A⃗ × B⃗ = AB sin 90° n̂ = AB n̂

blocks.text: 3. Do parallel vectors ka cross product null vector (zero vector) hota hai, kyun ke un ke liye θ = 0° ya 180°, aur sin 0° = sin 180° = 0:

blocks.text_alt: A⃗ × B⃗ = AB sin 0° n̂ = 0 or A⃗ × B⃗ = AB sin 180° n̂ = 0

blocks.text: 4. A⃗ × B⃗ ki magnitude us parallelogram ke area ke barabar hai jis ki do adjacent sides (saath wali sides) A⃗ aur B⃗ hon (Fig. 2.4 d).
